verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents built-in automation: monitors that check connected systems, violation alerts, access-review reminders, and an optional policy-approval workflow toggle. None of this shows a user-defined rule engine where you set a trigger event and a resulting action. These are vendor-defined behaviors and adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
